description: The settings an enrollment group owns exactly once. Holds the configuration that applies to the whole enrollment group rather than to a single agent group.
comment: A twin of its own rather than properties on the enrollment group, so settings can grow without versioning the enrollment group interface again and so a client can read them without loading the topology.

contents.name: AgentGroupLevels
contents.description: Levels of this enrollment group's agent topology, outermost first.
contents.comment: Bounded by the topology depth the API enforces - at most six levels below the enrollment group. Order is not expressible in DTDL and is carried by the API; the node does not enforce maxMultiplicity on write either, so this bound documents intent rather than a limit the platform upholds.
